data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 85.354m. During 2014 the syndicate experienced mixed prior year run-off development: net favourable run-off deviations of GBP 1.274m (a small overall release) driven by positive run-off in Motor (third party liability) partially offset by adverse development in Motor (other classes) and small adverse reinsurance inwards movements. Contributing causes cited include two large incurred claims affecting 2013 and a generally higher than expected level of attritional claims.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within the claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 is an Unexpired Risk Reserve of GBP 2.1m (31 December 2013: GBP 0.3m).

The 2013 year of account suffered a deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims during the year and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims.
The gross and net loss ratios for the 2013 and 2014 years of account have deteriorated.
Relentless competition in the marketplace, year on year reductions in premiums written and an increase in claims have negatively impacted performance.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year column). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision) was found in the notes; only net run-off deviation figures are provided in Note 7. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is taken from Note 7's net favourable/(adverse) run-off deviation total (GBP 1,274k) and reported as a release (-1.274m). Where gross figures were unavailable, net figures were used and flagged. LOB mapping: 'Reinsurance inwards' mapped to 'Treaty'. All amounts in report are presented in GBP 000; values converted to millions. Confidence levels reflect availability of gross vs net sources.
